name: openfang-rail
description: Neutral x402 rail for M2M commerce. Discover monetized tools, get an authoritative price quote, pay with a gasless EIP-3009 voucher, receive a signed receipt.

auth.note: no API keys; pay per call via the 402 challenge

payment.flow: 402 challenge -> EIP-3009 signed authorization (X-PAYMENT) -> 200 + signed receipt

tools.name: discover
tools.description: List monetized endpoints on the rail with their published price, payout wallet, and reputation.

tools.name: quote
tools.description: Get the authoritative 402 price quote for a specific endpoint call (recipient, amount, nonce, TTL).

note: input is always an OBJECT keyed by the tool's fields (never a bare string). Every tool call: POST /v1/tools/{tool}/call with body {"input": { ... }}. Machine-readable OpenAPI at /openapi.yaml is served by the worker, never shadowed by the static site.
